message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As a rough estimate—using a recent average rate of about $1 ≈ £0.78—you would get:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \approx £15.60
\]

So, $20 is roughly equivalent to **£15–£16**. For an exact figure at the time you’re converting, check a reliable financial news source, your bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app.
